extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Agents evaluator management page for the expanded "Residency Verification Agent" project. The "Evaluators" item is selected in the left navigation, and the main panel lists two existing evaluator cards: "Default Trajectory Evaluator" and "Default Evaluator."
